test_title: PYST 22: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate adverb to fill in the blank.

The explorers trekked ________ through the dense jungle.
solution:
The correct answer is '**bravely**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The adverb "**bravely**" describes the manner in which the explorers trekked through the dense jungle.

• It indicates that the explorers showed courage while moving through the challenging environment.
